The Dynamic Saunas Avila 1-2 Person Infrared Sauna offers a luxurious at-home wellness experience in a compact, space-saving design. Built from reforested Canadian Hemlock wood, this sauna provides low EMF far-infrared heating panels, chromotherapy lighting with a red light therapy feature, and a built-in Bluetooth audio system.

With energy-efficient heating, intuitive controls, and quick assembly, the Dynamic Saunas Avila Infrared Sauna is an excellent investment for health-conscious individuals.

Key Features of the Dynamic Saunas Avila Infrared Sauna

1. Space-Saving Design for 1-2 People

The Dynamic Saunas Avila Infrared Sauna is designed to fit comfortably in apartments, homes, and wellness spaces. It accommodates one or two users, making it ideal for personal relaxation or couples’ therapy sessions.

2. Six Low EMF FAR Infrared Heating Panels

Equipped with six low EMF FAR infrared carbon heating panels, this sauna provides deep-penetrating, evenly distributed heat. The panels are strategically placed on the back, sides, under the bench, and floorboard to ensure optimal heat exposure.

3. Premium Canadian Hemlock Wood Construction

Crafted from 100% reforested Canadian Hemlock wood, the Dynamic Saunas Avila Infrared Sauna offers excellent heat insulation, durability, and a naturally elegant finish. Hemlock wood resists warping and cracking, making it a long-lasting and sustainable sauna choice.

4. Bluetooth Audio System for Relaxation

The built-in Bluetooth and MP3 auxiliary connection allows users to listen to calming music, guided meditations, or audiobooks during sessions. The high-quality speakers enhance the relaxation experience.

5. Chromotherapy Lighting and Red Light Therapy

This sauna features full-spectrum chromotherapy lighting, which uses color therapy to enhance mood, relaxation, and energy balance. Users can choose different color settings for a more personalized sauna experience.

6. Energy-Efficient & Easy to Install

The Dynamic Saunas Avila Infrared Sauna operates on a 120V/15amp power system, making it compatible with standard home electrical outlets. The clasp-together assembly system ensures quick, hassle-free installation without professional assistance.

7. Tempered Glass Door & Modern Aesthetic

A bronze-tinted tempered glass door enhances the sauna’s modern aesthetic while ensuring safety and heat retention. The compact design makes it a stylish addition to any home.

Why Choose the Dynamic Saunas Avila Infrared Sauna?

  • Space-Saving 1-2 Person Design – Ideal for small homes, apartments, and wellness rooms.
  • Low EMF FAR Infrared Heating Panels – Ensures deep-penetrating heat while maintaining safety.
  • Premium Canadian Hemlock Wood – Durable, heat-insulating, and sustainable for long-lasting quality.
  • Modern Features – Bluetooth speakers, chromotherapy lighting, LED controls, and a tempered glass door.
  • Energy-Efficient & Easy to Install – 120V standard home outlets with a quick-assembly design.

Related Product – Dynamic Lugano 3-Person Infrared Sauna

For those who need a larger sauna with more capacity, consider the Dynamic Lugano 3-Person Infrared Sauna. It features a spacious design, advanced heating panels, and premium construction, perfect for couples or small families.
